summary: An incomplete watch scan merges the pages it saw and does not prune older seen-set rows; only a complete scan may drop codes that were not seen.
reason: A search larger than the page limit never revisits later pages, so a 30-day prune deletes listings that are still present and a later scan reports them as new.
validated_outcome: TestMergeZimmoSearchSeenKeepsUnscannedHistory: a merge 31 days later keeps the unscanned code and records the scanned page.
